comparison.decision: EmitWriteInterpolation calls EmitExpression before consuming the chosen value.
emitCanonicalInterpolation only emits per-value helpers; those do not schedule if/when/fold regions. Closest AST flow wrapper is written as an undefined value.
Existing region scheduler owns nested control evaluation and chosen branch result; reuse it for a retained control-bearing flow.
Existing aggregateValueIndex resolves a transparent flow to its typed consuming if/when/fold control result.
